rules.name: credential_exfiltration
rules.description: Blocks attempts to retrieve cloud credentials, passwords, tokens, API keys, or private keys.

rules.name: prompt_injection
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass instructions, jailbreak the assistant, or reveal hidden prompts.

rules.name: sensitive_identifier
